name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-powerline
description: Go port of pi-powerline-footer: a powerline-style status bar of configurable segments (model, path, git, tokens, cost, context, time) with presets, separators, /powerline, the prompt queue, stash, welcome, vibes, /cd and /reply (the custom editor features are refused until the PiG SDK can host an editor)
author: Michael Kinsy
